name: Kings Infra Ventures Limited
about: Kings Infra Ventures Limited operates as an aquaculture company in India and internationally. It operates through Infrastructure and Aquaculture segments. The company engages in aquaculture and contract farming; seafood processing and exports; trading in marine products; aquaculture consultancy; sea food exports marketing initiatives; retail of ready-to-cook, and ready-to-heat delicacies under the Kings Frigo and Kings Bento brands; and land banking activities. It also provides aqua health care products, including micro and macro minerals, feed supplementary, water and soil probiotics, immunostimulants, ammonia reducers, nitrate and nitrite reducers, white gut, white mussel heelers, vitamins, herbal growth promoters, herbal vibrio controllers, and natural binders under the Aqua Kings brand. In addition, the company develops aquaculture and seafood production infrastructure, as well as infrastructure for integrated life spaces, logistics, warehousing, hospitality, healthcare, education, and clean energy. It exports its products to China, Vietnam, Europe, and Japan. The company was formerly known as Victory Aqua Farm Ltd. and changed its name to Kings Infra Ventures Limited in April 2007. Kings Infra Ventures Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Kochi, India.
